lines.en: label day261:
scene wakanaayaneoffice1
: I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我他妈想死。

lines.en: It’s another normal day in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 又是 Kumon-mi 平凡的一天。

lines.en: The snow is falling, the girls are off doing girl-stuff, and Wakana Watabe is talking about dying in my office.
lines.zh: 雪在下，女生们跑去干女生的事，而 Wakana Watabe 正在我办公室里谈论死亡。

lines.en: That last one is a bit less common than the other two, but it’s slowly becoming yet another norm in my life.
lines.zh: 最后一件比前两件少见一点，但它正慢慢变成我生活里的又一项常态。

lines.en: : Do you need something?
lines.zh: : 你有什么事吗？

lines.en: : A new job.
lines.zh: : 想换份工作。

lines.en: : Japan still has capital punishment, so you might be able to find a job as an executioner or something like that.
lines.zh: : 日本还保留死刑，所以你也许能找份刽子手之类的工作。

lines.en: : Sounds absolutely wonderful.
lines.zh: : 听上去简直棒极了。

lines.en: : Really, though. Why are you here?
lines.zh: : 说真的。你来这儿干嘛？

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice2
: Is my presence disturbing you?
lines.zh: : 我的存在碍着你了？

lines.en: : Don’t you just use this office to flirt with your students anyway?
lines.zh: : 你这办公室不就是拿来跟学生调情的吗？

lines.en: : What could I possibly be interrupting right now?
lines.zh: : 我现在能打扰到什么？

lines.en: : I need to be ready to give slightly decent but also mildly self-destructive advice at any moment and you’re ruining my train of thought.
lines.zh: : 我得随时准备好给出那种还算体面、但又有点自毁倾向的建议，而你在打乱我的思路。

lines.en: : Rub my feet.
lines.zh: : 给我揉脚。

lines.en: : What? No.
lines.zh: : 什么？不要。

lines.en: : How did we get to that?
lines.zh: : 话题怎么转到这上面来的？

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} try standing and lecturing students all day and see how you feel. They fucking hurt.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}试试站一整天给学生讲课，看你什么感觉。他妈的疼死了。

lines.en: : Rub them.
: I’m just a little surprised you’re even considering letting me touch you.
lines.zh: : 我只是有点意外，你居然会考虑让我碰你。

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice3
: Ugh. You’re not gonna fucking get off to it, are you?
lines.zh: : 呃。你该不会他妈的想靠这个高潮吧？

lines.en: : I’ll just have Osako do it later if you’re going to be a fucking creep about it.
lines.zh: : 你要是打算他妈的变态起来，我待会儿让 Osako 揉就是了。

lines.en: : I’d like the record to reflect that I do not have a foot fetish before you go telling my karate instructor that I do.
lines.zh: : 在你跑去跟我的空手道教练说我有恋足癖之前，我想先声明记录在案：我没有恋足癖。

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice4
: Just kill me already.
lines.zh: : 干脆杀了我算了。

lines.en: Wakana kicks her shoes off and they go flying across the room, bouncing off of the wall before knocking a plant over.
lines.zh: Wakana 把鞋踢飞，鞋子横穿整个房间，从墙上弹回来，撞倒了一盆植物。

lines.en: It’s a plant I’ve never watered, so I’m kind of curious about how it’s still alive in the first place.
lines.zh: 那盆植物我从没浇过水，所以我有点好奇它到底是怎么活到现在的。

lines.en: Maybe it’s fake?
lines.zh: 也许是假的？

lines.en: : I take it you’ve heard from Miyamura about the latest batch of miscreants, right?
lines.zh: : 我想你已经从 Miyamura 那儿听说最新一批问题儿童的事了吧？

lines.en: : I have not. This is the first I’m hearing about it.
lines.zh: : 没有。这是我第一次听说。

lines.en: : We’re already getting more?
lines.zh: : 又要来人了？

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice5
: We?
: {i}You{/i} were exempt from these ones for some fucking reason I have yet to comprehend.
lines.zh: : 不知道他妈的什么原因，这次{i}你{/i}被豁免了，我到现在都没想明白。

lines.en: : Meanwhile, they tossed a fucking anarchist and a girl who does nothing but write haiku into mine on Monday.
lines.zh: : 与此同时，周一他们往我班上扔了个他妈的无政府主义者，还有一个整天只写俳句的女生。

lines.en: : Well those definitely sound like students that should have gone to me instead. I’m the one who handles all of the girls with weirdly specific personalities.
lines.zh: : 那听起来确实更该分给我。我才是负责那些性格奇怪得特别具体的女生的人。

lines.en: : Take them and give me Miyamura. That offer will literally always be there.
lines.zh: : 把她们带走，把 Miyamura 给我。这个提议随时都算数。

lines.en: : If you can get Makoto to agree, sure. I have no problem with that.
lines.zh: : 只要你能让 Makoto 同意，没问题。我一点意见都没有。

lines.en: : I just can’t imagine she’d want to leave.
lines.zh: : 我只是想象不出她会想走。

lines.en: Frankly, I {i}would{/i} have a problem with Makoto leaving.
lines.zh: 说实话，Makoto 要走我{i}可{/i}受不了。

lines.en: I’m just so confident in her being around forever that the thought of her somehow disappearing has never even occurred to me.
lines.zh: 我太确信她会永远在我身边了，以至于她会以某种方式消失这个念头，我从来没想过。

lines.en: Obviously not counting when the world ends, I mean.
lines.zh: 当然，世界末日那种情况不算。

lines.en: But pretty much {i}everyone{/i} disappears for that, so...
lines.zh: 不过到那时候基本{i}所有人{/i}都会消失，所以……

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice6
: You’re right. I imagine you have a good amount of blackmail on her already, given how long she’s been around you.
lines.zh: : 您说得对。她在您身边待了这么久，我想您手里已经攒了不少她的把柄。

lines.en: : Such a shame to see a good girl like her led down the wrong path by someone with a shattered moral compass.
lines.zh: : 看着她这样的好姑娘被一个道德罗盘碎了一地的人带偏，真是可惜。

lines.en: : As much as I appreciate you coming into my office to insult me, I’d like to know if there’s some sort of...end point you’re trying to reach with this discussion.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很感谢你专程来我办公室羞辱我，但我想知道这番对话……有没有什么你想达到的目的。

lines.en: : Everyone else is old and annoying. This is the only office I can take my shoes off inside of.
lines.zh: : 其他人都又老又烦。这是我唯一能脱鞋的办公室。

lines.en: : We can just ignore each other if you’d prefer that.
lines.zh: : 你要是愿意，我们就互相无视好了。

lines.en: : That would make me feel even stranger, to be completely honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，那样反而让我觉得更别扭。

lines.en: : Then I guess we’re stuck with each other until I’m able to summon the strength to carry on with my life.
lines.zh: : 那看来在我攒够力气继续过日子之前，我们得一直凑在一起了。

lines.en: : Oh, good. So you’ll be in here for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。也就是说你会在这儿待到地老天荒。

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : Send my regards to Osako. She’ll be wondering where I am when I don’t wash the dishes tonight.
lines.zh: : 替我向 Osako 问好。今晚我要是不去洗碗，她会奇怪我跑哪儿去了。

lines.en: : You actually do work around the house?
lines.zh: : 你还真在家干活？

lines.en: : You should see me in an apron.
lines.zh: : 你该看看我穿围裙的样子。

lines.en: : You wear an {i}apron{/i}?
lines.zh: : 你穿{i}围裙{/i}？

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice7
: It was a joke, you fucking imbecile.
lines.zh: : 那是个玩笑，你这个蠢货。

lines.en: : Do you really think I’d spend the five seconds it would take to put an apron on instead of accepting that all clothes inevitably get dirty and need to be washed?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我会为了穿个围裙花上五秒钟，而不是干脆接受所有衣服迟早会脏、都得洗这个事实吗？

lines.en: : That haiku girl is really getting to you, huh?
lines.zh: : 那个写俳句的女生真的把你烦坏了啊？

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice8
: Let me die in spring.
lines.zh: : 让我死在春天吧。

lines.en: : Sensei! It’s Ayane! Your favorite student and soon to be mother of your children!
lines.zh: : Sensei！是我 Ayane！您最喜爱的学生、即将为您生儿育女的人！

lines.en: : It’s probably best to not let [teenage]girls insinuate that you’re habitually impregnating them loud enough for the rest of the staff to hear.
lines.zh: : 最好别让[teenage]女生大声暗示您经常把她们搞怀孕，大到能让其他教职员工都听见。

lines.en: : Hm? Did I hear Ms. Watabe just now?
lines.zh: : 嗯？我刚刚是不是听到 Watabe 老师的声音了？

lines.en: : Sensei! I’m coming in!
lines.zh: : Sensei！我进来啦！

lines.en: : If your pants are off, I’m going to be really sad!
lines.zh: : 要是您裤子已经脱了，我会非常伤心的！

lines.en: scene black
Ayane swings the door open and lunges forward, only to stop herself when she realizes that I am not impregnating someone other than her.
lines.zh: Ayane 一把推开门扑了进来，随即意识到我并没有在让她以外的人怀孕，才硬生生停住。

lines.en: Wakana would make a horrible mother anyway.
lines.zh: 反正 Wakana 要是当妈，肯定糟透了。

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice9
: Heeeeeeeeeeeeeeey...
: Are you going to apologize for storming in or is that a thing we just don’t care about anymore?
lines.zh: : 你打算为闯进来道歉吗，还是说这事我们已经不在乎了？

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice10
: On behalf of the Amamiya family, I humbly apologize and accept any perverted things you wish to make me do in order to repent.
lines.zh: : 我代表 Amamiya 家诚挚道歉，并愿意接受您想让我做的任何变态的事来赎罪。

lines.en: : Ms. Watabe didn’t die and turn into a ghost in the last five seconds did she?
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师该不会在这五秒里死了、变成鬼了吧？

lines.en: : God, I wish.
lines.zh: : 天哪，我也希望。

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice11
: No, but it’s Ms. Watabe. She’s kind of infamous for not getting involved in anything outside of her paygrade.
lines.zh: : 没有啦，不过那是 Watabe 老师。她出了名地不会掺和职责范围以外的任何事。

lines.en: : Therefore, I can say all the pervy stuff I want and everyone still wins.
lines.zh: : 所以我想说多色的话都行，大家都不亏。

lines.en: : I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我他妈想死。

lines.en: : She’s also well known for her overwhelmingly positive outlook on life.
lines.zh: : 她还以极度积极向上的人生态度闻名。

lines.en: : Yeah, that checks out.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这倒对得上。

lines.en: : Oh, and she’s dating our karate instructor.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，她在和我们空手道教练交往。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Yeah. I caught them making out once.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我撞见她们亲热过一次。

lines.en: : They were really going at it, too. And in broad daylight.
lines.zh: : 而且当时真叫一个投入。还是光天化日之下。

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice2
: What?
lines.zh: : 干什么？

lines.en: : Are you going to confirm or deny this claim?
lines.zh: : 你打算证实还是否认这个说法？

lines.en: : That I can be outside in broad daylight?
lines.zh: : 证实我能在光天化日之下出门？

lines.en: : I can. It just hurts.
lines.zh: : 能。只是有点难受。

lines.en: : No...That you and Osako are dating.
lines.zh: : 不是……是你和 Osako 在交往。

lines.en: : Is who I sleep with of that much importance to you?
lines.zh: : 我跟谁上床，对你来说有那么重要吗？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say {i}important{/i}, but...
lines.zh: : 说不上{i}重要{/i}，不过……

lines.en: : But you want me to open up about my personal life because we're “friends” and “friends” tell each other things.
lines.zh: : 但你想让我敞开心扉谈谈私生活，因为我们是「朋友」，而「朋友」之间是无话不谈的。

lines.en: : Closer. Still not quite there, though.
lines.zh: : 接近了。不过还差一点。

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice3
: Oh.
: A perverted reason.
lines.zh: : 一个变态的理由。

lines.en: : Why am I even remotely surprised?
lines.zh: : 我到底在意外什么？

lines.en: : First, you reveal your foot fetish. Now, you’re picturing me with my girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 先是暴露了你的恋足癖，现在又开始想象我和我女朋友。

lines.en: : Foot fetish?
lines.zh: : 恋足癖？

lines.en: : Sensei, you should have told me you were into that sort of thing. I don’t mind doing a little experimenting.
lines.zh: : Sensei，您早该告诉我您喜欢这种的。我不介意试一试。

lines.en: : I don’t have a foot fetish, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我没有恋足癖，Ayane。

lines.en: : Deceiver. He nearly pounced on me when I asked him to massage my feet earlier.
lines.zh: : 骗子。我让他给我揉脚的时候，他差点扑上来。

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice12
: You’re...that close with Ms. Watabe?
lines.zh: : 您和 Watabe 老师……已经这么熟了吗？

lines.en: : I still don’t understand her that well, but I’m pretty sure this is just how she messes with people.
lines.zh: : 我到现在也不太懂她，但我敢肯定，这就是她捉弄人的方式。

lines.en: : Hey. Blonde girl.
lines.zh: : 嘿。金发女生。

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice13
: I’m a blonde girl.
lines.zh: : 我就是金发女生。

lines.en: : Do you need something, Ms. Watabe?
lines.zh: : 您有什么事吗，Watabe 老师？

lines.en: : If you’re worried about me revealing how frisky you were getting with my karate teacher, I can promise you it will remain a secret so long as you don’t tell anyone else in[school] I’m pregnant.
lines.zh: : 如果您是担心我泄露您和我空手道老师亲热的事，我可以保证守口如瓶，只要您别跟[school]里其他人说我已经怀孕了。

lines.en: : You are not pregnant, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你没有怀孕，Ayane。

lines.en: : That’s what {i}you{/i} think.
lines.zh: : {i}您{/i}是那么以为的。

lines.en: : Come over here and massage my shoulders.
lines.zh: : 过来给我揉揉肩。

lines.en: : Are your feet not tired anymore?
lines.zh: : 你的脚不酸了？

lines.en: : I don’t let people I barely know touch my feet. Shoulders are fine.
lines.zh: : 我不让不太熟的人碰我的脚。肩膀可以。

lines.en: : Okay, I really have a hard time understanding how close we are, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我是真的搞不懂我们到底有多熟，Wakana。

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice14
: Obviously close enough to use her first name...
lines.zh: : 显然熟到可以直呼其名了……

lines.en: : I use literally everyone’s first name.
lines.zh: : 我对所有人都是直呼其名的。

lines.en: : It’s different with older girls. They’re intimidating.
lines.zh: : 对年长的女生不一样。她们让人发怵。

lines.en: Wakana intimidates me, too, but...I’m pretty sure it’s in a slightly different way than it is for Ayane.
lines.zh: Wakana 也让我发怵，不过……我敢肯定，这和 Ayane 的那种发怵稍微有点不一样。

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice15
: Hah...yes...
: Finally...
lines.zh: : 终于……

lines.en: : Actual...relaxation...
lines.zh: : 真正的……放松……

lines.en: : Why is Ayane doing this instead of me? This is very much up my alley.
lines.zh: : 为什么是 Ayane 在揉而不是我？这活儿我可太拿手了。

lines.en: : You took too long, Sensei. Now it falls on me to help Ms. Watabe unwind.
lines.zh: : 您磨蹭太久了，Sensei。现在只能由我来帮 Watabe 老师放松。

lines.en: : Don’t tell our karate teacher I did this, though, or she won’t let me come to class anymore.
lines.zh: : 不过别跟我们空手道老师说我做了这个，不然她不让我去上课了。

lines.en: : If you even...have class...anymore...
lines.zh: : 你们还有没有……课可以上……都难说……

lines.en: : The other...rich girl...is close to...finalizing the purchase of the dojo...
lines.zh: : 另一个……有钱人家的女生……快要把道场买下来了……

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice16
: Is that so?...
lines.zh: : 是这样吗？……

lines.en: : That’s...okay, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那……也行吧，我想。

lines.en: : I can always just find somewhere else to train...
lines.zh: : 我总可以另找地方训练……

lines.en: : And if her dad thinks owning a dojo will make her happy...I can’t blame him for trying.
lines.zh: : 而且如果她爸爸觉得买个道场能让她开心……我也怪不着他想试试。

lines.en: : Will Osako get to keep her job at least?
lines.zh: : 至少 Osako 能保住工作吧？

lines.en: : Beats me...ask her yourself...
lines.zh: : 我哪知道……你自己去问她……

lines.en: : We don’t...talk a lot about work...
lines.zh: : 我们……不怎么聊工作……

lines.en: : I’ll make sure to fit that in between my questions about proper kick techniques and my formal apology for Ayane watching you two make out.
lines.zh: : 我一定会把这个问题插进「正确踢技」的提问、以及为 Ayane 撞见你们亲热而正式道歉之间。

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice17
: It was only for a few seconds. I doubt they even saw me.
lines.zh: : 就几秒钟而已。我怀疑她们根本没看见我。

lines.en: : Going to weigh in on that, Ms. Watabe?
lines.zh: : 要对此发表点意见吗，Watabe 老师？

lines.en: : Nope.
: I don’t...care either way...
lines.zh: : 怎么样我……都无所谓……

lines.en: : It’s nothing to be...ashamed about...
lines.zh: : 这没什么好……羞耻的……

lines.en: : It’s just like any other relationship...except...there are more bath towels...
lines.zh: : 就像任何一段恋情一样……只不过……浴巾多了点……

lines.en: : You never struck me as a bath towel collector.
lines.zh: : 我从来没觉得你是收集浴巾的人。

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice18
: Why are you still here?
lines.zh: : 你怎么还在这儿？

lines.en: : This...is my office.
lines.zh: : 这……是我的办公室。

lines.en: : Shhh...getting stressed only causes more tension.
lines.zh: : 嘘……一紧张只会更僵硬。

lines.en: : And judging by how rough your shoulders feel, I’m pretty sure yelling at Sensei right now could paralyze you for life.
lines.zh: : 而且从您肩膀僵成这样来看，我敢肯定现在冲 Sensei 吼能让您终身瘫痪。

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound all that bad. I could live off of government assistance and read all day.
lines.zh: : 听起来也没那么糟。我可以靠政府救济过日子，整天看书。

lines.en: : But then who would mold the minds of all of the willing and impassioned students in your class?
lines.zh: : 那谁来塑造你班上那些心甘情愿、充满热情的学生的思想？

lines.en: : Anyone with access to a fucking textbook and the ability to keep their hands to themselves.
lines.zh: : 任何一个有他妈的教科书、而且管得住自己手的人。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forgot how fucked up things are in Class A.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我忘了 A 班乱成什么样了。

lines.en: : Just a textbook will suffice, then.
lines.zh: : 那有一本教科书就够了。

lines.en: : For most students, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少对大多数学生来说。

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice19
: But then, along come the anarchists and the poets and, what do you know, you’ve suddenly got an even more obnoxious class to teach than you did just last week.
lines.zh: : 可接着无政府主义者和诗人就来了，你猜怎么着，你手上的班突然就比上周更难教了。

lines.en: : I think all of the new students might be getting to Ms. Watabe.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这些新学生可能快把 Watabe 老师逼疯了。

lines.en: : I think Ms. Watabe was done long before the new students started showing up.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Watabe 老师早在新生出现之前就已经完了。

lines.en: : I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我他妈想死。

lines.en: : Sensei, are we going to be getting any more?
lines.zh: : Sensei，我们还会再来人吗？

lines.en: : Fourteen is a weird number and I’m pretty sure the other classes have more than double that.
lines.zh: : 十四个是个很奇怪的数字，而且我敢肯定其他班的人数比这多一倍都不止。

lines.en: : The other classes also have teachers.
lines.zh: : 其他班好歹还有老师。

lines.en: : She’s got a point.
lines.zh: : 她说得有道理。

lines.en: : You’ll...hah...get more...
lines.zh: : 你们……哈……还会来人的……

lines.en: : And if...for some god forsaken reason...you don’t...
lines.zh: : 而且如果……出于某个被神遗弃的理由……你们没来……

lines.en: : I will pawn more of mine off on you...
lines.zh: : 我就再塞几个我的学生给你……

lines.en: : There’s only...so much more I can take...before I...
lines.zh: : 我还能……撑的了不多了……再这样下去我就……

lines.en: scene wakanaayaneoffice20
: Shh...everything is going to be okay, Ms. Watabe.
lines.zh: : 嘘……一切都会好起来的，Watabe 老师。

lines.en: : Soon, you’ll be back at home with my karate teacher and all of your bath towels- making out and washing each other's hair in the shower.
lines.zh: : 很快您就能回家，和我的空手道老师、还有您所有的浴巾在一起——亲热，在淋浴间互相洗头。

lines.en: : We shower...alone...
lines.zh: : 我们……各自洗……

lines.en: : That’s a waste of water and you should reconsider.
lines.zh: : 那太浪费水了，您该重新考虑一下。

lines.en: : I shower with my friends all the time and it’s truly a wonderful bonding experience.
lines.zh: : 我经常和朋友一起洗澡，那真是特别棒的增进感情的方式。

lines.en: I need to figure out a way to get into the dorm showers.
lines.zh: 我得想个办法混进宿舍的淋浴间。

lines.en: Hopefully on a day that Maya or Yumi aren’t there as I would like to leave with all of my limbs still attached...
lines.zh: 最好挑 Maya 或 Yumi 不在的那天，因为我还想四肢完好地离开……

lines.en: scene black
The three of us remain in the office for another hour or so before we decide it’s time to head home.
lines.zh: 我们三个在办公室又待了一个小时左右，才决定是该回家的时候了。

lines.en: Well, Ayane and I decide that.
lines.zh: 好吧，是我和 Ayane 决定的。

lines.en: Wakana, still winding down from Ayane’s rather enticing shoulder massage, elects to take a nap on the couch and agrees to lock the place up once she leaves in another hour or two.
lines.zh: Wakana 还沉浸在 Ayane 那相当诱人的肩部按摩里，选择在沙发上小睡一会儿，并答应过一两个小时走的时候帮忙锁门。

lines.en: Not that I care if she even locks up in the first place.
lines.zh: 反正她锁不锁门我根本不在乎。

lines.en: Like, who is going to raid my office after hours in a[school] that also happens to be locked?
lines.zh: 说真的，在一所本来就上锁的[school]里，下班后谁会来洗劫我的办公室？

lines.en: And even if someone does, it’s not like I’m keeping evidence of my sexual relationships here.
lines.zh: 就算真有人来，我又没把性关系的证据藏在这儿。

lines.en: But I digress.
lines.zh: 不过扯远了。

lines.en: The true takeaways from today are as follows:
lines.zh: 今天真正的收获如下：

lines.en: Wakana is a lesbian. (Or bisexual.)
lines.zh: Wakana 是同性恋。（或者双性恋。）

lines.en: So is my karate instructor.
lines.zh: 我的空手道教练也是。

lines.en: Oh, and I’m also probably going to be getting new students soon.
lines.zh: 哦，还有，我大概很快也会有新学生。

lines.en: But the most important takeaways are the first two.
lines.zh: 不过最重要的收获是前两条。

lines.en: Unless the new students are cute.
lines.zh: 除非新学生很可爱。

lines.en: Then all three takeaways are important.
lines.zh: 那三条就都重要了。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : You seem lost in thought.
lines.zh: : 您看起来在想心事。

lines.en: : Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 一切都好吗？

lines.en: : Hm? Yeah.
lines.zh: : 嗯？挺好的。

lines.en: : Everything’s fine.
lines.zh: : 一切都好。

lines.en: : Just...
lines.zh: : 只是在……

lines.en: : Thinking about lesbians.
lines.zh: : 在想同性恋的事。
